description: A modular, stack-agnostic toolkit for AI coding agents to autonomously find, reproduce, and patch vulnerabilities.

written.description: Reads a codebase and its commit history, builds a threat model from them, and sends agents to chase each hypothesis it raises. It then tries to reproduce each finding in a sandbox and attacks its own patch to check the fix holds, working from source alone with no running target.

alive.last_commit_message:
fix(dedupe,remote): wire live structured consolidation and write_file rebuild hook

Live end-to-end verification across multi-campaign, multi-pass, and
split-plane remote sandbox runs surfaced four integration gaps:

- Include open candidate statuses (`valid`) in `is_consolidatable_status`
  while continuing to exclude dismissed, mitigated, archived, and merged
  rows, and expand `code_paths` hop arrows (`->`) during candidate
  cluster construction.
- Drive Tier-2 semantic deduplication and aggregate report synthesis
  through `ResilientLiteLlm.generate_content_async(structured_llm_request(...))`.
- Return recoverable `Error:` validation feedback from `report_findings`
  on `pydantic.ValidationError` so an agent that self-corrects an invalid
  field on the next turn does not poison campaign exit status, and key
  `--passes > 1` spend-report entries per pass.
- Trigger `RemoteTargetEnvironment.run_rebuild()` when `write_file`
  updates a non-`workspace/` target file so `patcher` rebuilds remote
  targets before re-running exploit verification.

Change-Id: I6d0feb9497a4b849fec071b69563c868aeef42c6
